messages.content: 你能提供關於電影《全面啟動》的簡介，然後再幫我檢索有關同一部電影《全面啟動》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息，以及電影《黑暗騎士》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息嗎？

function.name: movie_details_brief
function.description: This function retrieves a brief about a specified movie. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

extra_info.description: Option to get additional information like Director, Cast, Awards etc.

message.reasoning:
The user wants a brief about the movie "全面啟動" (which is "Inception") and then retrieve additional info like director, cast, awards for both Inception and The Dark Knight. We need to use the function movie_details_brief. The function signature: movie_details_brief takes title: string, extra_info?: boolean. So we can call it twice: once for Inception with extra_info true, once for The Dark Knight with extra_info true. Then we need to provide the brief first. But the brief is also part of the function? The function returns brief if extra_info false; but we want brief plus extra info. The user says: "你能提供關於電影《全面啟動》的簡介，然後再幫我檢索有關同一部電影《全面啟動》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息，以及電影《黑暗騎士》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息嗎？"

So we need to provide a brief about Inception, then retrieve extra info for Inception and The Dark Knight. We can do two calls: one for Inception with extra_info true, which will return brief + extra info. Then we can do another call for The Dark Knight with extra_info true. Or we could do separate calls: one for Inception brief only, then Inception extra info, then The Dark Knight extra info. But the function only returns brief or brief+extra info. If we set extra_info true, we get brief + extra info. That satisfies the brief requirement. So we can just call Inception with extra_info true, then The Dark Knight with extra_info true.

Thus we need to output the function calls. According to guidelines, we should not output anything else besides the function calls. So we produce two function calls.
